note: Sentences that must NOT become a scored guidance claim (live-run review, POLYCAB, 2026-11-13). Each was scored as delivered/beat by the earlier rules. 'expect' is what extraction may produce: nothing, or an item whose period is open (no year / medium term).

cases.why: a target already achieved, stated as an achievement
cases.quote: This is a momentous occasion by us as we have achieved our first-ever 5-year guidance of reaching ₹ 200 billion top-line by FY26, ahead of the committed timeline.

cases.why: a reported figure for calendar 2024, not guidance
cases.quote: Our calendar year 2024 top-line stands at ₹ 210 billion, a 5% overachievement, that too over a year ahead of the targeted period.

cases.why: a revenue-mix target (international share), not revenue growth
cases.quote: Our next target is to grow the share of international business to north of 10% of the overall Company's revenue.

cases.why: a segment's actual for the year just ended, restated as EBITDA
cases.quote: Chirayu Upadhyaya: EBIT margins for cables and wires for the year were at 13.6%, so EBITDA margins would have been in the range of 14% to 15%.

cases.why: a long-term band with no year: open, never resolved
cases.quote: But otherwise, the longer- term guidance will continue to be the 11% to 13% EBITDA margins.
